description: Headless GIMP: create a live, editable text layer or restyle one, chosen with `op` (create, set_content, set_font, set_color, set_alignment, set_box) — the same ops and parameters as ps_text, plus a fixed `box` with wrapping and `fit`. create adds a layer at `x`/`y` with `text`, `font_size` in points, and optional font_name, red/green/blue and alignment; it reports layer_id, name, bounds, the image ppi and the font size in pixels. The set_* ops change the text layer named by `layer_id` or `layer` (a non-text layer is refused). Fonts accept a family ("Inter") or full name ("Inter Bold"), case-insensitive; a miss is refused with the closest installed names (list them with gimp_inspect what=fonts). Text is capped at 2000 characters, and a layer that would render past the size limit is refused and leaves the document unchanged. GIMP supports LEFT, CENTER, RIGHT and FULLYJUSTIFIED alignment only. `box` {width, height?} (create, set_box) fixes the text box so text wraps at `width`; `fit` shrinks the size to approximately the largest size at which the wrapped text fits a box with both sides; the result then carries `box` and, for fit, `fitted` and `fit_probes`. Text sits at the top of the box (no vertical alignment). There is no undo in this session: gimp_checkpoint or gimp_save_xcf first when in doubt.

alignment.description: Text alignment. GIMP supports LEFT, CENTER, RIGHT and FULLYJUSTIFIED; the other values ps_text accepts (LEFTJUSTIFIED, CENTERJUSTIFIED, RIGHTJUSTIFIED) are refused. In a box, alignment applies within the box width.

box.description: create, set_box: a fixed text box {width, height?} in image pixels (each side 1 to 30000, area within the text-box cap: 64 MP at 8-bit, 32 MP at 16-bit, 16 MP at 32-bit). The text wraps at `width` (newlines in the text are kept) and is placed at the top of the box; GIMP has no vertical alignment, so a taller box leaves the space below. Omit `height` and the layer grows to the wrapped text's height. The box survives later set_content / set_font / set_alignment edits. Emoji and some scripts depend on installed fonts and may render as empty boxes.

fit.description: create, set_box: with a `box` that has both width and height (at most 16 MP), shrink the text to approximately the largest size (at most font_size, or the current size for set_box) at which the wrapped text fits inside the box, searched in at most 12 trial renders. A word wider than the box counts as not fitting. The result reports `fitted`: false when even min_size overflows (the text is left at min_size).

font_name.description: Font family ("Inter", "Open Sans") or full name ("Inter Bold"), case-insensitive. create: omit for a default sans. A name that matches nothing is refused with the closest installed names; gimp_inspect what=fonts lists them all.

font_size.description: Font size in points, 1 to 1296, converted to pixels with the image resolution. create: initial size (default 24). set_font: new size (omit to keep the current size).

image.description: Image id, as returned by gimp_open_document.

layer.description: set_*: name of the text layer to change. Ignored when layer_id is given. Not used by create.

layer_id.description: set_*: id of the text layer to change (create reports it; gimp_inspect flags text layers with is_text_layer). Takes priority over `layer`. Not used by create.

min_size.description: fit only: the smallest font size to try, in pixels (default 8).

op.description: create: a new text layer at the top of the stack with `text` at `x`/`y` (default 100,100) and `font_size` (default 24), optionally with font_name, red/green/blue and alignment. set_content: replace the text with `text`. set_font: set `font_name`, `font_size`, or both (omit font_name to resize in the current font). set_color: set red/green/blue. set_alignment: set `alignment`. set_box: put the layer in a fixed `box` (re-wrapping its text). The set_* ops act on the text layer named by `layer_id` or `layer`.

red.description: Text colour red, 0-255. red, green and blue go together.

text.description: create: initial text. set_content: the new text, replacing the existing text. At most 2000 characters. For a line break, put a newline character in the string (not a backslash followed by n).

x.description: create only: the layer's left edge in document pixels.

y.description: create only: the layer's top edge in document pixels.

name: gimp_text

box.description: create / set_box with a box: the resulting box in pixels.

fit_probes.description: fit only: trial renders used (at most 12).

fit_seconds.description: fit only: time the search took.

fitted.description: fit only: false when even min_size overflows the box.

font_size_px.description: The font size in pixels at the image resolution (the height of a line).
